authoritative_source.document: AMD Sea Islands Series Instruction Set Architecture

facts: It writes D0 to DS[ADDR + offset0*4] and D1 to DS[ADDR + offset1*4].
OFFSET0 and OFFSET1 are the two 8-bit DS offset fields.
The DS encoding uses ADDR, DATA0 and DATA1 VGPR source fields.
The DS instruction encoding is 64 bits, with encoding bits 31:26 equal to 110110.

proof.topic: V_MUL_LO_I32 VOP3a and SGPR source legality
facts: Its result is the low-order 32 bits of signed integer multiplication D.i = S0.i * S1.i.
VOP3a SRC0 accepts SGPR0-SGPR103 and VGPR0-VGPR255 among its legal source selectors.
VOP3a SRC1 and SRC2 use the same source-selector format as SRC0.
Therefore the observed v_mul_lo_i32 VGPR, VGPR, SGPR form is architecturally legal.

approved_forms.source_closed_reason: Opcode 14 is a two-dword DS/LDS write with ADDR, DATA0 and DATA1 VGPR sources. CLRX omits offset0 when its encoded value is zero.
Opcode 14 is a two-dword DS/LDS write using the two encoded 8-bit offset fields and three VGPR source roles.

The architectural instruction still has ADDR, DATA0 and DATA1 VGPR source roles; the structural parser intentionally deduplicates identical physical register names, so DATA0==DATA1 yields two distinct VGPR names in the use set.
V_MUL_LO_I32 is VOP3a opcode 363 and VOP3 source selector fields permit SGPR sources.

semantic_boundary.policy: These forms are admitted only because the AMD Sea Islands ISA independently proves their opcode, operand classes, width and structural read/write role. Their occurrence in LocalShader does not by itself promote shader-stage ownership or higher-level expression semantics.
